description: allowedCommands is the allowlist for repository postUpgradeTasks. With it empty, every task a repository asks for is skipped with 'Post-upgrade task did not match any on allowedCommands list' and the branch is pushed half-updated. Each entry is a regex anchored to one literal command; the command runs from the repository checkout with the runner's user, so an entry means trusting that repository's writers with this runner. See https://docs.renovatebot.com/security-and-permissions/#trusting-repository-developers.
